verdict.rationale: Probes confirm llms.txt returns HTTP 200 at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt, and .md variants of docs pages (e.g. billing.md) are also served, showing genuine agent-oriented documentation access; Stripe also provides an official MCP server further supporting agentic doc/tool access. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of agents actually using llms.txt in practice.
